sql: with o as (select lo.id, lo.market_ticker, split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, lo.created_at, lo.status, case when split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXWTI','KXWTIW','KXAAAGASD','KXAAAGASW') then 'oil+gasoline' else 'metals+natgas+brent' end as grp from live_orders lo where lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and lo.side='no' and lo.action='buy' and lo.limit_price between 90 and 95 and split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXGOLDD','KXGOLDW','KXBRENTD','KXBRENTW','KXNATGASD','KXWTI','KXWTIW','KXAAAGASD','KXAAAGASW','KXCOPPERD','KXSILVERD')), h as (select o.*, (select t.hours_to_close from mmsell_candidate_ticks t where t.market_ticker=o.market_ticker and t.captured_at<=o.created_at order by t.captured_at desc limit 1) as htc from o), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select grp, case when htc is null then 'z unknown' when htc<3 then 'a <3h' when htc<8 then 'b 3-8h' when htc<24 then 'c 8-24h' else 'd 24h+' end as placed_htc, count(*) as orders, sum(case when status='filled' then 1 else 0 end) as filled, sum(case when status='filled' and p.realized_pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) as filled_losers from h left join p using (market_ticker) group by 1,2 order by 1,2
